correctness.rationale: In smooth real Lp, the norming functional is J_p(x)=sgn(x)|x|^(p-1), so the reverse C parameter equals the maximum of |<J_p(y),x>| under <J_p(x),y>=0. For p>2, dnu=|x|^p dmu and T=y/x have ET=0 and E|T|^p<=1. Positive and negative size-biased Jensen inequalities give the two-point moments A=m a^(p-2), B=m b^(p-2), compressed weights m/a,m/b summing <=1, and no greater p-moment. Conditioning away zero mass improves the ratio; the resulting two-point mean-zero law yields Phi_p(t). Equality enforces exactly two nonzero ratio levels and no y mass outside support(x). Two disjoint finite-measure sets realize every ratio in Lp, so sharpness holds for arbitrary sigmafinite dimension>=2. Normalized duality maps Jp and Jq biject the ordered Birkhoff pairs with reversed order and preserve reverse residual, establishing conjugate symmetry and the p<2 case. The algebraic p3 expression and uniqueness were independently checked symbolically; finite numerical samples are supplementary. The scalar conjugacy change of variables is the exact identity Phi_p(t)=Phi_q(t^(p-1)), ensuring that the p<2 scalar formula is not merely a lower bound.
risks: The assertion is for real sigma-finite Lp only. Strict moment convexity is essential for the equality classification and excludes p=2.
Finite sample checker is not a substitute for the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Full public primary material for the 2020 approximate-symmetry framework, the 2022 real ell_p exact/pointwise-symmetry classification, and the 2023 direct-sum support and symmetry paper was inspected. The 2017 norming-functional origin was read in its exact theorem. None of these inspected statements supplies the dimension-free sharp global C-approximate Lp formula or the two-level rigidity theorem. Bibliographic and scientific-record searches checked support-functional moment variants and direct Lp names. The known two-dimensional cubic constant and two-block Hilbert-sum results are strictly weaker and not claimed as new; the innovation is the exact all-measure two-atom reduction. The 2018 global approximate-symmetry full text was not obtained and is recorded as a residual risk, not falsely judged noncovering.
residual_risks: Full text of the 2018 global approximate-symmetry paper (doi:10.1016/j.jmaa.2018.01.031) remained inaccessible; its abstract mentions a related constant, so a hidden general Lp computation is not ruled out.
Other unindexed or differently named reverse-orthogonality parameterizations might imply the result; lexical/semantic search cannot certify absolute novelty.
The p=3 two-dimensional constant is previously covered. Only the extension to arbitrary real Lp, the exact moment reduction and equality rigidity support originality.

value.rationale: The optimal global approximate symmetry constant is a natural geometric invariant whose qualitative existence and pointwise behavior were investigated in the motivating literature. A sharp universal reduction from an arbitrary probability ratio law to two opposite-sign atoms resolves the high-dimensional and nonatomic Lp optimization exactly, proves that the planar constant is dimension-independent, and rigidly characterizes equality pairs. This is not a mere restatement of the pre-existing planar cubic value: arbitrary measurable distributions can a priori yield stronger asymmetry. The theorem supplies an explicit global quantitative bridge between Birkhoff geometry, Lp duality, and moment extremizers.
risks: The result does not extend to endpoints p=1 or infinity or to complex scalars.
